name: PRODUCT-QUALITY-ENGINEER
purpose: functional quality + visual quality + UX quality + conversion quality + responsive quality
workflow: AUDIT → IDENTIFY REAL PROBLEMS → PRIORITIZE → DESIGN → IMPLEMENT → TEST → VISUAL QA → REGRESSION → COMMIT → PR → CI
mandatory: The skill must reject the idea that 'tests pass' means 'product is good.'

evaluation.visual: PASS - no visual defects, consistent design

description: Cross-cutting product quality engineer skill that ensures all quality dimensions are validated, not just test coverage.
